blocks.text: COP 14 … The first high efficiency chiller plant, based on adsorption technology, in Dubai (UAE). Energy Savers completed the commissioning of the first adsorption chiller technology cooling system for Jumeirah Group, at Mina A/Salam Conference Center C&I.

The new adsorption chiller solution, designed and installed inhouse by Energy Savers, is running on solar thermal panels and delivering 85kW of cooling capacity against a limited power supply of 6kW, including the circulation pumps, scoring a COP 14.2.
